name: omnilab/opentargets
description: Omnilab Open Targets: a target by its Ensembl gene, a disease or phenotype by its EFO, Mondo, HPO or Orphanet id, a drug by its ChEMBL id - names, descriptions, locations, classes, therapeutic areas, parents, mechanisms of action, indications - their associations with scores, drugs and clinical candidates, UniProt, HGNC, OMIM and Orphanet ids, InterPro domains and Reactome pathways, a search, and the associations paged, through the Open Targets Platform's GraphQL API, no key needed.
